notes:
Opportunity snapshot:
- Vertical: B2B SaaS (customer support platform + ticketing for mid-market fintechs).
- Pain: high MTTR for email/ticket triage, 28% SLA misses during peak; looking for aggressive ticket deflection and agent-assist.
- Data: ~10M historical tickets (text + attachments), 2.2M knowledge base articles/snippets after preprocessing. Indexing scale is primary concern.
- Workload: real-time support-agent retrieval + on-load ticket deflection widgets on web + nightly batch reranks for surfacing articles. Peak traffic expected 150-200 qps (support busiest hours).
- SLOs: 95th percentile end-to-end retrieval+rerank latency target <= 150ms (goal 100ms). Agent experience requires top-5 precision high (>85% relevance in QA tests).
- Cost constraints: finance requests forecasted cost per customer query <= $0.02 (including retrieval and light rerank). Need Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization.
- Model preferences: open-vocab embeddings, embed dimensionality trade-off; prefer 1536-2048 dims if cost allows. Reranker: lightweight cross-encoder tuned for top-5 reordering; fallback to sparse BM25 for cold starts.
- Routing/fallback: must support region-aware routing (EU-first for EU customers), graceful fallback to cheaper model variant during congestion, and policy to avoid sending PII out of region.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 Type II + SSO (SAML + Okta), audit logs for retrievals, KMS for keys, data residency requirement for EU customers. Legal wants DPA covering subprocessor list.
- Integration: Zendesk + Intercom + in-house ticket store (Postgres). Wants prebuilt connectors and Delta ingestion pipeline (attachments -> OCR -> chunking -> dedupe).
- Pilot ask: ingest 500k tickets + KB, run 4-week A/B vs baseline search, measure deflection rate uplift, p95 latency, and cost per query.
- Quote from CTO: "We can tolerate some microsecond variance but cannot sacrifice top-N accuracy — agent trust is everything."
- Channel notes: SE call 2026-02-28 (Fireflies ID above) — covered architecture options: Dedicated vs Hosted with VPC peering.
- Internal red flags: they ran an internal reranker last year; it reduced latency but had poor top-5 quality. They want clear eval harness and prompt/promote datasets.
- Recommended Redwood approach: Start Hosted API with dedicated routing + Optimize recommendations for batching. If pilot meets p95 latency and cost, move to Dedicated pools with EU-backed nodes and optional private control plane.
